appeal.reasoning: The insurer's decision to partially approve the claim for cataract surgery, citing clause STAR-SEC1-C03, appears to be consistent with the policy wording. Clause STAR-SEC1-C03 explicitly states: 'Expenses for Cataract surgery (per eye) shall be limited to 25% of the Sum Insured or Rs. 40,000, whichever is lower, per eye, per Policy Year.' The approved amount of Rs. 20789 is lower than Rs. 40,000, indicating that the '25% of the Sum Insured' limit was likely the lower applicable amount, or another valid calculation within the clause was applied. No other provided candidate clause contradicts or overrides this specific sub-limit for cataract surgery, nor do they provide a basis for an appeal to increase the approved amount. Other clauses relate to waiting periods, co-payment, room rent, or unrelated conditions, none of which support an appeal against the application of the cataract sub-limit in this context.
